title: Child overweight, Small island developing states (SIDS), by location
headline: In 18 of 25 SIDS, child overweight was higher in urban than in rural areas in the latest survey
subtitle: Prevalence of overweight (weight for height >+2 standard deviation from the median of the World Health Organization (WHO) Child Growth Standards) among children under 5 years of age.
years: Latest surveys with both groups, 2010 to 2022; median gap 0.6 points.
data_line: Data: WHO Global Health Observatory via UN System Data Commons, indicator NUT_ANTH_SH, extracted 1 Nov 2026
alt: In 18 of 25 SIDS, child overweight was higher in urban than in rural areas in the latest survey. Latest surveys with both groups, 2010 to 2022; median gap 0.6 points. Gap between rural areas and urban areas in 25 countries, ranked; 7 with rural areas higher, 18 with urban areas higher.
method: Method: gap within each country's latest survey with both groups.
question: Where have you seen the gap in child overweight between rural areas and urban areas close, and how was it measured?
